description_en: Creates a backup set for an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于为RDS实例创建一个备份集
name: CreateBackup

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of databases. Separate multiple databases with commas (,).
This parameter takes effect only when the BackupStrategy parameter is set to db
parameters.help_zh:
数据库列表，多个数据库之间用英文逗号（,）隔开。
满足以下条件时，该参数生效：已传入BackupStrategy参数（取值为db）
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en:
The backup strategy. Valid values:
db: database-level backup.
instance: instance-level backup.

This parameter takes effect only when the following conditions are met:
For MySQL: The BackupMethod parameter is set to Logical.
For SQL Server: The BackupType parameter is set to FullBackup
parameters.help_zh:
备份策略，取值：
db：单库备份
instance：实例备份

满足以下条件时，该参数生效：
MySQL：已传入BackupMethod参数（取值Logical）。
SQL Server：已传入BackupType参数（取值为FullBackup）
parameters.name: backup_strategy

parameters.help_en:
The backup method. Valid values:
Logical: logical backup. This value is supported only for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances with local SSDs.
Physical: physical backup. This value is supported for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances with local SSDs, ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server, and ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL.
Snapshot: snapshot backup. This value is supported for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances with cloud disks, ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server, ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL, and ApsaraDB RDS for MariaDB.

Default value: Physical.

When you use logical backup, the database must contain data.
ApsaraDB RDS for MariaDB instances support only snapshot backup, but you must set this parameter to Physical
parameters.help_zh:
备份类型，取值：
Logical：逻辑备份（仅MySQL本地盘支持）
Physical：物理备份（MySQL本地盘、SQL Server、PostgreSQL支持）
Snapshot：快照备份（MySQL云盘、SQL Server、PostgreSQL、MariaDB均支持）

默认值：Physical。

使用逻辑备份时，数据库内需要有存储数据（数据不为空）。
MariaDB实例仅支持快照备份，但参数取值请填写Physical
parameters.name: backup_method

parameters.help_en:
The backup type for an ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instance. Valid values:
Auto: The system automatically selects full backup or incremental backup. This is the default value.
FullBackup: full backup.

This parameter takes effect only when the BackupMethod parameter is set to Physical
parameters.help_zh:
SQL Server实例备份方式，取值：
Auto（默认值）：自动选择全量备份或增量备份
FullBackup：全量备份

该值仅在BackupMethod参数为Physical时生效
parameters.name: backup_type

parameters.help_en:
The retention period of the backup set.
SQL Server: If the BackupStrategy parameter is set to db, the BackupMethod parameter is set to Physical, and the BackupType parameter is set to FullBackup, you can specify the retention period of the backup set. Valid values: 7 to 730, and -1. A value of -1 indicates long-term retention (LTR). Unit: days.
MySQL: You can specify the retention period of the backup set. Valid values: 7 to 730, and -1. A value of -1 indicates long-term retention (LTR). Unit: days
parameters.help_zh:
SQL Serevr：当参数BackupStrategy为db、BackupMethod为Physical且BackupType为FullBackup时，支持指定备份集的保留时间，取值7~730天、-1（长期保留）。
MySQL：支持指定备份集的保留时间，取值 7~730 天、-1（长期保留）
parameters.name: backup_retention_period

BackupJobId.description_en: The ID of the backup task
